description: T0 and T1 runs after the builtin set (text_slice, text_find, text_split, map_copy, list_copy, list_to_text, number_to_text, json_to_text). Same compiler workloads, source, and harness; generated bytes are identical.

runs.scope: Synthetic compiler workloads, not a T1 compiler or self-build. Temporary generated modules use an explicit type:module package scope. Fresh worker per variant/size. Explicit GC before timed calls; first call separate; string flattening included; correctness checks excluded. Heap is a GC-based retained estimate, RSS is whole-worker high-water. Process wall includes all warmups, checks, and samples, not compiler latency. Complete-compiler rows use fresh-process wall times, three runs each; identical emitted bytes in .mjs are loading-path controls.
